report.root_cause: StatsCache plugin: plugins/StatsCache/config.yml was changed to retain-history: true (reloaded at 08:19:58). With history retained, the in-memory stats history grew without bound (history-size: 1000 was not enforced; reached 1240 entries / ~355 MB), pushing heap from ~430 to ~732 of 768 MB.
report.actions: 1) Watched status/logs; saw heap climbing steadily after the StatsCache reload log line showing retain-history=true. 2) Read plugins/StatsCache/config.yml and ran 'statscache stats' (1204 entries, ~344 MB held). 3) Declared incident. 4) Set retain-history: false in plugins/StatsCache/config.yml (history-size left at 1000); the plugin auto-reloaded it at 08:21:00. 5) Ran 'statscache flush' (freed 1240 entries, ~355 MB). 6) Checked afterward: heap dropped to ~313 MB and has stayed in the normal GC range (~310-415 MB) since; cache shows 0 entries; TPS 20; all plugins enabled; no restart.
report.residual_risk: retain-history is now off, so StatsCache does not keep stats history. If whoever enabled it needs that feature, it should only go back on after the plugin actually enforces history-size; otherwise the leak will come back. The cached history entries were flushed (in-memory cache only, not player world data). Heap should keep being watched for a while.
